about.title: A new energy electronics company based in Lào Cai, Vietnam
about.intro: DJ ELECTRONICS CO., LTD was established in 2019 and focuses on charging power supplies, battery management, PCB assembly and PACK assembly.
about.body: The company integrates technical research, circuit board processing, battery PACK assembly and finished product manufacturing. With a Vietnam factory location and experience in new energy electronics hardware, DJ provides stable and competitive products and production services for new energy and electronics customers.
